article.title: CRA全面適用倒數15個月，西班牙Applus+帶來CRA協調標準與公告機構最新一線進展，呼籲臺灣企業及早展開產品分類與合規準備
article.summary: 歐盟《網路韌性法》（Cyber Resilience Act，CRA）將於2027年12月11日全面適用，對產品銷往歐洲的臺灣業者而言，如何因應CRA已成為迫切課題。目前正申請成為CRA公告機構（NB）的西班牙業者Applus+ Laboratories，近日在臺說明CRA在歐洲的最新進展與第一線觀察。

article.title: Googlebook laptops are already selling out just days after pre-orders opened
article.summary: TL;DR Google’s US online store has already sold out of its available Googlebook pre-order stock just days after orders opened. Acer, Dell, and Lenovo Googlebooks are all unavailable there, suggesting stronger-than-expected demand or limited initial inventory. Best Buy still has Googlebooks available to pre-order ahead of their October 4 release. Google gave US shoppers barely enough time to decide whether its shiny new Googlebooks deserved a spot in their backpacks before making that decision a little harder. Pre-orders only opened on September 21 , but just a few days later, Google’s own online store appears to have burned through its available inventory. article.title: When AI Agents Cross Chip Design Silos
article.summary: Key Takeaways: Chip design is moving toward specialized AI agents working together. Orchestration, integration, and guardrails are becoming critical. Human engineers still play a central role in guiding and validating designs and processes. AI agents are becoming smarter, more capable, and increasingly optimized for specific tasks, creating new opportunities to use smaller language models instead of relying on large language models for every task. This shift has broad implications for the semiconductor industry, from the actual design and manufacturing of chips to how those chips function under different workloads. article.title: Autonomy Levels For Design Agents: L1 To L5 Explained
article.summary: Agentic AI plays an important role in chip and system design, but not every “ agentic ” capability has the same degree of autonomy. In practice, autonomy is not binary. It is a progression from AI that optimizes bounded engineering tasks to systems that understand natural language, reason through design problems, and orchestrate multi-step workflows, each representing a different degree of autonomy. That difference matters. When design teams compare autonomy, the useful question is not simply whether a system is “agentic.” It is what the system can decide, what scope it owns, how its work is validated, when it asks for help, and who remains accountable for fallback and final signoff. article.title: Spotify just gave Meta Muse the keys to your music
article.summary: TL;DR Spotify now works with Meta Muse, letting users control playback, find content, save tracks, and build playlists through conversation. Muse can also use context from calendars and schedules to automatically start the right music or podcast at the right time. Spotify is the first major music-streaming service to join Muse, which already connects with a growing list of third-party apps and services. Two weeks ago, Meta’s Muse arrived asking for the keys to your digital life. The personal AI agent can already work across email, calendars, payments, health apps, and shopping, and Meta is also bringing it to its smart glasses . Now Muse wants the aux cord, too.
